newsitem.title: CANADA: Westcoast British Columbia gas plant set for work.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast British Columbia gas plant set for work.

text.p: Westcoast Energy Inc will start a 20-day scheduled maintenance turnaround at its 350 million cubic feet a day Pine River gas plant in northeastern British Columbia on Sunday, a company executive said.

The plant was expected to process about 175-180 million cubic feet of gas a day for most of the period, when the company planned to work on two sulphur and process trains, Westcoast field services division president Irv Koop said in a telephone interview on Thursday.
The flow rate was expected to be reduced to zero on August 27 and 28, then climb back up to about half-capacity until the work is completed on September 7, Koop said.

Westcoast's entire British Columbia pipeline and processing network has a capacity of about two billion cubic feet a day, although an average of 1.2 billion cubic feet a day normally flows in the summer months. ((Jeffrey Jones, Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
